snippet.title: Skygate Zero - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist and find out more about Skygate Zero on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3654150/Skygate_Zero/

Explore the flooded future on your customisable Glideboard. Ride, trick, wallride and grind the wasteland, smash enemies, grab Shards, and tune your setup as you reconnect the Skyways and find your line to the impossible.
